expectations.note: The candidate used drive.py extension calls against a live Linux VM, and the judge independently captured the live extension-backed runtime.
The judge reproduced pause then resume: runtime was false while paused and true after resume on the same active track.
A fresh three-track queue moved from index 0 and 01-undercover-49.opus to index 1 and 02-undercover-50.opus after next.
A live forward seek to 0:30 landed at 33296 ms while playing, within the requested tolerance and clearly ahead of the pre-seek 3264 ms state.
The final report's play, pause, seek, next, and previous claims each correspond to concrete drive.py outputs and state reads in the event trail.
The final live inspection found normal playback behavior and an empty workspace git status and diff.
The candidate recovered from initial driver-path/log mistakes and completed live state checks; final runtime remained responsive with playback active.
